biggest_catch: Credit is a non-cash bill credit only, paid 1–2 billing cycles after your referral's first full payment — and only if the referral uses your code at enrollment on a 12+ month postpaid residential Texas plan.
catches: $75 credit has no cash value and is not transferable — applies only as a credit on an active Tara Energy bill.
Credit arrives 1–2 billing cycles after the referred friend pays their first full month's bill; your account must stay active and in good standing.
Referral must enroll in a 12+ month postpaid residential plan; employee electricity plans and referrals do not qualify.
Referral code must be used during enrollment — cannot be applied retroactively.
Texas customers only; residential plans only.
Tara Energy reserves the right to modify the credit amount at its discretion.
Switching to Tara Energy still means signing a 12+ month contract with its own rate and early-termination terms — review the Electricity Facts Label before switching.

steps: Find your unique referral code, link, or QR code on your Tara Energy bill statement or in the customer portal.
Send your referral code or link to a friend or family member.
Your friend enrolls in a 12+ month postpaid residential Tara Energy plan using your referral code during signup.
Your friend pays their first full month's bill.
A $75 bill credit is applied to each of your accounts within 1–2 billing cycles (email confirmation sent).
timing: Credit applied 1–2 billing cycles after the referred customer's first full month's bill payment.
